symbols.name: prime transform length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries of the sequence that the transform acts on; here a prime.
symbols.quote: Let $q$ be a prime, the number of entries of the sequence $u=(u_0,\dots,u_{q-1})$.

symbols.name: input sequence
symbols.meaning: The sequence of $q$ entries that the transform acts on.
symbols.quote: Let $q$ be a prime, the number of entries of the sequence $u=(u_0,\dots,u_{q-1})$.

symbols.name: normalized Fourier transform
symbols.meaning: The normalized discrete Fourier transform of length $q$, mapping $u$ to $(F_q u)_k$.
symbols.quote: Let $F_q$ be the normalized [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) of length $q$, so that $(F_q u)_k=\frac1q\sum_{j=0}^{q-1}u_j e^{-2\pi i jk/q}$ for $0\le k<q$.

relations.quote: Gaussian resampling expresses each source Fourier transform through a power-of-two tensor transform.
Gaussian resampling operates on the prime axes produced by the [Chinese-remainder address map](chinese-remainder-address-map.md).
